methodology: Six complete interleaved rounds, rotation stride5 across16 variants, alternating mode order. Each scenario starts fresh server, admits all300 routes/JWT/CORS/Zod, resets, warms500 six-step journeys, resets, measures5000 journeys, verifies5000orders/0carts. Separate server/client processes, native framework HTTP stack, common JWT verifier and payload schemas. No affinity/quota for any contender.
limitations: In-memory carts/orders; no database, persistence, network payment gateway or inventory locking
Active personal desktop; background contention recorded but uncontrolled; client and server share host
300 business routes represent50shops x6operations; Nile single endpoint dispatches300actions
Plain disables payload Zod only; Nile retains protocol envelope validation
tRPC uses native procedure paths and response/error envelopes
Encore has one extra authenticated coordinator-only route; CPU/memory omitted because launcher is outside real application container
Node and Bun results belong to explicitly labeled runtime tracks; small differences with overlapping ranges are inconclusive
